response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS ppd FROM film WHERE rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL AND rental_duration <> 0 GROUP BY rating), a AS (SELECT AVG(ppd) AS avg_ppd FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.ppd) AS avg_price_per_day, AVG(r.ppd - a.avg_ppd) AS avg_above FROM r CROSS JOIN a WHERE r.ppd > a.avg_ppd
